name: bpmn-js
summary: A production BPMN 2.0 modeler built on diagram-js and used by Camunda/bpmn.io. It is excellent when the model is BPMN, but it is not a general draw.io-style editor, and the licence includes a bpmn.io watermark clause.
losses: Customizing beyond BPMN is high effort
blockers: BPMN-specific editor, not a general diagram editor.

spike.scenario: Documented ecosystem analysis; no local browser spike.
spike.notes: Not spiked as a general editor: BPMN-only and watermark clause. Use bpmn-js only for BPMN/process modeling.
